// Written into a generated app's cmd/version by
// TestVersionTemplate_matchesClimaxOnRecordedBuilds, with APP_IMPORT replaced.
package version_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime/debug"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"APP_IMPORT/cmd/version"
)

var out = flag.String("out", "", "where to write the JSON report")

func TestDump(t *testing.T) {
	files, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join("testdata", "buildinfo", "*.txt"))
	if err != nil || len(files) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("no fixtures: %v", err)
	}
	report := map[string]*version.Info{}
	for _, f := range files {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(f)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		bi, err := debug.ParseBuildInfo(string(data))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		report[strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(f), ".txt")] = version.GetVersionInfoFrom(bi, stampFromLdflags(bi))
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(report)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(*out, data, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

// stampFromLdflags recovers the link-time stamp from a recorded -ldflags setting.
func stampFromLdflags(bi *debug.BuildInfo) version.Stamp {
	stamp := version.Stamp{Version: "dev"}
	set := map[string]*string{
		"Version": &stamp.Version, "Commit": &stamp.Commit, "CommitDate": &stamp.CommitDate,
		"TreeState": &stamp.TreeState, "BuiltBy": &stamp.BuiltBy,
	}
	for _, s := range bi.Settings {
		if s.Key != "-ldflags" {
			continue
		}
		for _, field := range strings.Fields(s.Value) {
			target, value, ok := strings.Cut(field, "=")
			if !ok || !strings.Contains(target, "/cmd/version.") {
				continue
			}
			if p, ok := set[target[strings.LastIndex(target, ".")+1:]]; ok {
				*p = value
			}
		}
	}
	return stamp
}
